messages:
Alex: Ran into a funky onboarding hiccup: ruby sampleapp streaming tests keep getting 401s on first chunk. Fresh machine, followed quickstart exactly.
Maria: Oh no. Which quickstart (docker vs local gem)?
Alex: local gem. rbenv 3.2.2, bundle, export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat ~/token.txt) — token.txt came from console and has a trailing newline. Error in logs: '401 Unauthorized - invalid_api_key' then client reconnects and fails again.
Jonathan: If the header contains a newline that could break auth. Can you paste the request header (redact token)?
Alex: Header snippet shows: Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
 — there's a literal newline at the end of the value.
Maria: Classic. `$(cat file)` preserves newline. On linux shell you'd usually trim. Could be CRLF too if token was created on windows. Try `od -c token.txt` or `xxd` to confirm.
Alex: `od -c token.txt` -> "61 62 63 \n" so it's a trailing \n. Worked around with `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(tr -d '\n' < token.txt)` and streaming auth passes.
Sam: Quick fix is to change sampleapp README to recommend `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(tr -d '\n' < token.txt)` or use an .env loader. I'll open a tiny PR.
ci-bot: Created PR devex/#1421: "trim env token in sampleapp + add CI lint". CI currently has a windows path flake.
Jonathan: Longer term: ruby SDK parity note — our Go/JS fallbacks already strip whitespace when reading env. Ruby client should call `.strip` on env-derived token to avoid this class of error.
Maria: Agreed. We should add a unit test asserting no trailing newline in Authorization header for streaming requests. Also add an integration smoke to sampleapp CI to catch this early.
Alex: One caveat: if a user intentionally includes leading/trailing spaces as part of token (unlikely), strip could change semantics. But tokens are opaque; trimming is ok. Document decision in CHANGELOG.
Sam: I'll add docs blurb in quickstart: sample command snippets for common token sources (copy-paste vs file). Example snippet: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(printf '%s' "$(cat token.txt)")` or `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(tr -d '\\r\\n' < token.txt)` for cross-platform.
Jonathan: For the SDK change, add a minor version bump and release note: v1.4.1 patch for auth newline. Also add a README note in devex repo about CI lint that checks token files used in tests for stray whitespace.
ci-bot: Devex PR #1421 updated with `.strip` in SDK fallback path, unit, and sampleapp README change. Pipeline rerun queued after windows runner fix.
Maria: Filed follow-up issue to audit other community SDKs for parity (strip-on-env, streaming auth behavior) and to ensure our onboarding snippets across repo examples include the trimming guidance.
Alex: Retested locally after applying `.strip` in env read path — streaming auth OK. Will wait for CI + green before merging.
Sam: Merged once CI fixed. Released ruby SDK v1.4.1. Added tiny onboarding blurb to quickstart. :tada:
